title: Shipping
description: Full-viewport checkout screen composing the checkout-form and order-summary blocks: the shipping step, where a shopper gives an email for the receipt, the shipping address and a delivery method beside the order they are paying for, with the form's saving and error states and the summary's loading, error and empty states. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container) across the @sm, @md and @lg contract steps: the masthead lines up at @sm; the footer lines up at @md; the order summary moves beside the form at @lg.
